game_concept: A action puzzle set in Mystic Forest – Moonlit Clearing, a moonlit clearing: the druid must handle bramble beasts while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Reverse Countdown: Count backward with range(10, 0, -1) to time perfect launches.
theme: Mystic Forest – Moonlit Clearing: a moonlit clearing
core_gameplay_loop: In Moonlit Clearing, repeat each round: Count backward with range(10, 0, -1) to time perfect launches. Each round, a new healing herbs challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the launch_timing value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Collect 210 points of healing herbs by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 210, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 6 (applied tier): Reverse Countdown
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Reverse Countdown' (Week 5 slot 8), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Moonlit Clearing'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mystic Forest
region.mood: airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how launch_timing changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against bramble beasts in Moonlit Clearing.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 210 within 63 seconds.
